headline: Explore the globe in field recordings
summary: Earth Garden offers a global map of real-world field recordings. Experience ambient sounds from diverse locations for work, sleep, or active listening. Discover subtle nuances of nature or urban soundscapes.

headline: iPhone Handoff will seamlessly share one number between two phones
summary: iOS 27 introduces iPhone Handoff for seamless number sharing between two devices. The feature was teased at WWDC and now has a detailed setup demo. Easily switch calls or messages between your iPhones using a single number.

headline: CD sales are booming as physical media continues its resurgence
summary: CD sales surged by 45.7% in the first half of 2026, selling 17.5 million units. This marks a significant rebound for physical media, according to the RIAA report. The resurgence highlights a growing interest in tangible music formats.

headline: Fantasy Footballers’ Andy Holloway is a dedicated zero-inbox kinda guy
summary: Andy Holloway, cohost of the popular Fantasy Footballers podcast, reveals his strict zero-inbox email strategy. His award-winning podcast boasts over 2 million monthly listeners. The interview explores his meticulous organizational habits beyond the show.

headline: How to Watch the September 2026 Nintendo Direct and Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct
summary: Nintendo is hosting two major Direct showcases in September 2026. Get ready for a regular Nintendo Direct and a special Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct. Learn everything you need to know to tune into these back-to-back events.

headline: Left 4 Dead 2 Dev Admits Valve Intentionally Leaked Its Own Trailer After the ESRB Blocked It from Release
summary: Former Valve writer Chet Faliszek confessed Valve deliberately leaked a Left 4 Dead 2 trailer. The leak occurred after the ESRB prevented its official release. This reveals a surprising behind-the-scenes tactic from the game developer.

headline: Insomniac Clears the Air After Marvel's Wolverine Fans Confuse Lady Deathstrike for Psylocke
summary: Insomniac Games addressed fan confusion over a Marvel's Wolverine trailer. Viewers mistakenly identified Lady Deathstrike as Psylocke in the new footage. The studio clarified the character's identity to set the record straight.

headline: Zach Cregger Says He's Done With Franchise Films After Resident Evil
summary: Director Zach Cregger will exit franchise filmmaking after his Resident Evil adaptation premieres. He states this will be his last foray into established movie series. Cregger is days away from his survival horror film's theatrical debut.

headline: US envoys set for Ukraine talks after meeting Putin in Moscow
summary: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Putin in Moscow. They expressed hopes for "equally productive meetings" in Ukraine. The talks aim to facilitate peace discussions between the nations.

headline: Disruption at Port of Dover as masked 'stop the boats' protesters block roads
summary: Masked "stop the boats" protesters caused hours-long disruption at the Port of Dover. They blocked roads, impacting port operations and travel. The government condemned the behavior, labeling it as unacceptable.

headline: Nigel Farage tells BBC he 'wasn't listening' during foreign donor talks filmed undercover
summary: Nigel Farage claimed he "wasn't listening" during undercover filmed foreign donor talks. The Reform leader also told the BBC that his family wants him to quit politics. This comes amidst controversy surrounding his party's funding.

headline: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
summary: The US and Iran have exchanged retaliatory attacks on ships amid escalating tensions. The US claims to have struck three Iranian oil tankers. Iran, in turn, reported targeting three US-linked vessels.
